items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'John Cashman' and his brother playing drums, but when the interviewer clarifies that 'Bill Cashman' is the saxophone player (John's brother), the interviewee does not confirm knowing Bill personally, only acknowledging the interviewer's information.

ctx.x: Mutt Carter, yeah. He had his own band, but he had, John Cashman was playing with him, see. Me, I was playing with him. They had, they had two, uh, two Cashmans. John, John Cashman, John had a brother, played drum. His brother's name now. Yeah.

I can't remember. I know there's a Sam that played guitar and a Willie that played, Bill Cashman that played saxophone. Well, he got a brother, had a brother played drum. Well, I, I, I know, I asked John that and he told me. So I got it down on tape, you know.

Well, that's, that's about what I, uh, most I can remember now. What about, what about Willie Santiago? Did he play? Santiago was a guitar player, good, good. Did you ever hear him play mandolin? Yeah, he was a good mandolin player. Mm-hmm. Yeah, he was, he was great. Mm-hmm. Willie Santiago, yeah. Did he play mandolin in a band or a lot? No, no. Just, like we all, all of us was doing for sport, for playing, for pleasure like that, most, friends like that. Mm-hmm. Never did, we never did go out, we never made…
